source.notes: Schedule 2.01 (Commitments) is not attached to the filed exhibit; aggregate commitment is taken from the defined term, which governs in any case. Twelve lenders sign the agreement (syndicated). No term loan tranche exists; the sole facility is the revolving credit facility.

notes: facility_name: the agreement never assigns a defined name to the facility (no "Revolving Credit Facility" term). "Revolving Loans" is the label used in §2.01 and throughout Article II; the defined term is the singular "Revolving Loan" ("a Loan made pursuant to Section 2.01"). Cover page CUSIP line reads "REV".

maturity_date: "Effective Date" is defined as the date the §4.01 conditions are satisfied, not a calendar date, so the document states no hard date — basis is relative. §2.22 permits up to two one-year extensions; not reflected in the field.

applicable_margin_bps: deferral null. Ratings-based five-category grid (Eurodollar Spread 0.795% / 0.900% / 1.000% / 1.200% / 1.300%; ABR Spread 0.000%–0.300%; Facility Fee Rate 0.080%–0.200%). The agreement does not state an opening category; it defers to the Ratings applicable on any given day. Not the silence fallback — the agreement is explicit that the answer lives in the external rating.
has_margin_grid: the Eurodollar Spread itself steps with ratings, so this is a true margin grid (not merely a fee grid). The facility fee also has a grid keyed to the same categories.

interest_rate_benchmark: Eurodollar Rate resolves to LIBOR administered by ICE Benchmark Administration. §2.10 (Replacement of Rate) defines Term SOFR / Daily Simple SOFR as Benchmark Replacement fallback language only — conditional, not operative. Benchmark floor at zero (Eurodollar Rate clause (c)).

Excluded from facility records: Letter of Credit Sublimit ($200,000,000, "part of, and not in addition to, the total Commitments"); Swingline Loans (sublimit within Commitments); §2.20 Increase in Commitments (accordion, up to $500,000,000 — an option, not a commitment).

notes: covenant_type: Consolidated Adjusted Funded Debt = Total Debt + operating lease liabilities (FASB 842); Total Debt is all Indebtedness with no cash netting → gross. Lease-adjusted (EBITDAR denominator); the enum has no lease-adjusted variant, so classified on lien scope (total) and netting (gross) per the rule. Hesitation recorded: `other` is the alternative reading.

initial_threshold / step_down_schedule: §6.08 proviso raises the level to 4.25:1.00 for four consecutive fiscal quarters following acquisitions with aggregate consideration ≥ $1,000,000,000 in a 12-month period (Leverage Increase Testing Period), with a requirement that the ratio be ≤ 3.75 for two consecutive quarters before any subsequent holiday. This is a covenant holiday (conditional override); the non-holiday level 3.75 is recorded and the schedule is confirmed flat.

testing_frequency: compliance certificate under §5.01(c) is delivered with annual and quarterly financial statements and demonstrates compliance with §§6.08 and 6.09 as of the end of each such period.
springing_trigger: tested unconditionally every period; absence null, no citation required.

notes: covenant_type: the label is the neutral "Consolidated Coverage Ratio"; classified by definition. Denominator is interest expense plus rent expense, i.e. fixed charges, and numerator is EBITDAR — the standard rent-adjusted fixed charge coverage construction. Not `interest_coverage` because the denominator is not interest alone. Hesitation recorded: the schema does not define what counts as a fixed charge; a labeler who reads `fixed_charge_coverage` as requiring scheduled principal in the denominator would choose `other`.

testing_frequency: §6.09 is tested for "any period of four fiscal quarters"; the §5.01(c) certificate demonstrating compliance accompanies each quarterly and annual delivery, so the test is quarterly.
step_down_schedule: confirmed flat — a single level with no table.
